dominant_breach: essential-risk coverage priced through opaque credit, external-data, and surveillance variables
fastest_washout: premium shock or denial before the household can inspect factors or switch coverage

score_mediated_exclusion_gate.note: Insurance and surveillance-pricing systems are an active exclusion gate when essential coverage or prices rely on opaque credit, external consumer data, or individualized behavioral data.

insurance_credit_score_use.note: Credit-based insurance scores can affect underwriting/rating, making financial distress feed into protection costs.

insurance_external_data_algorithmic_pric.note: State and NAIC governance materials show that insurer AI/external-data use needs documented controls, exams, and unfair-discrimination testing.

surveillance_pricing_personalization.note: Personalized prices can use location, behavior, demographics, browsing, and purchase data; the case must ask whether essential prices become privately segmented tolls.

model_audit_disparate_impact_testing.note: Governance rails exist, but certification requires actual model-inventory, feature, examination, and outcome evidence.

adverse_action_reason_specificity.note: Reason specificity must reach the actual data/factor/vendor level, not only generic underwriting categories.

proof_debt: premium and denial spread by credit/insurance-score decile and protected group
surveillance-pricing incidence in essential goods and services
regulatory examination and consumer correction outcomes

gate_17_score_mediated_exclusion.why: Gate 17 is blocked: insurance and surveillance pricing cannot pass without factor visibility, adverse-action specificity, disparate-impact testing, and affordability evidence for households exposed to loss.

evidence_debt_register.question: premium and denial spread by credit/insurance-score decile and protected group
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Collect decision-level insurance quoting, rating, cancellation, and renewal outcomes by state, score band, product, and subgroup.

evidence_debt_register.question: external-consumer-data and model feature inventories
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Require insurers and vendors to identify source data, proxies, model class, validation, and adverse-action reason mapping.

evidence_debt_register.question: surveillance-pricing incidence in essential goods and services
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Distinguish nonessential personalized discounts from individualized tolls on necessary goods, services, or protection.

evidence_debt_register.question: regulatory examination and consumer correction outcomes
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Track state examination findings, consumer notices, correction success, and whether model fixes are retroactive.

validation_notes: rev0330 promotes this scoreboard from seed to active in the Gate 17 score-mediated-exclusion burndown; certification remains blocked unless correction, explanation, dispute, appeal, and transaction-preservation rails are shown.
